description: Find canonical QuoAPI capability handles by intent, ID or provider; catalog metadata are not upstream API results. Use query="*" to enumerate MCP-visible capabilities (limit 1–20; offset 0 then next_offset until null). Inventory returns total/count/next_offset; keyword search returns up to limit matches without total. Provider/region filters restrict but never grant access. Results do not prove tenant authorization, a connected account or live provider availability. Use quoapi.describe for contracts; quoapi.inspect for runtime health.

limit.description: Page size between 1 and 20 (default 8). For query=*, read next_offset from the response and continue until it is null; keyword search returns at most this many matches.

offset.description: Zero-based inventory cursor (default 0), valid only with query=*. Start at 0 and pass the response next_offset on each subsequent request; never increment beyond the returned total.

provider.description: Optional upstream provider ID/name (e.g. loqate) to filter to currently eligible routed capabilities. It does not inspect or authorize a tenant connection; omit to search across providers.

query.description: Intent or exact capability ID (e.g. address.validate), or provider name (e.g. Loqate). The only wildcard is the literal * for a filtered complete inventory; pass offset/limit to page through it.

region.description: Optional coverage-region code; results include matching region and global capabilities. Omit for every permitted region. Filtering cannot override region or release policies.

name: quoapi.search
title: Search QuoAPI capabilities
